title.narrative: PROMOVENDO O ACESSO A JUSTIÇA EM MOÇAMBIQUE

description.narrative: 1. Assess the role and capacity of the Ombudsman's Office and the National Human Rights Commission to promote gender equality in Northern Mozambique;2. Strengthen the Ombudsman's Office, the National Human Rights Commission and justice institutions in northern Mozambique to prevent human rights violations and promote gender equality.3. Disseminate legislation on the rights, duties and fundamental freedoms of citizens, with special emphasis on women's rights, in areas sensitive to conflict.4. Investigate situations of violation of the law and make recommendations to the competent authorities, namely the Assembly of the Republic, the Attorney General of the Republic and authorities at central or local level.5. Involve the government, local leaders, community radio stations and civil society organizations in promoting and supporting access to justice and gender equality, as well as contributing to the re-establishment of the social contract between the population and State institutions .

Improve access of displaced women and girls to justice services, restore trust in state justice and security institutions, which are gender sensitive.This objective will be achieved by strengthening the capacity of the Ombudsman's Office and the National Human Rights Commission (CNDH) to prevent human rights violations, promote access to justice, equality between men and women and cohesion, in collaboration with other justice institutions and civil society organizations (CSOs).
